definitions.explanation: One's parent's sister, or the wife of one's parent's sibling.

examples.japanese: おば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{東京|とうきょう}→東京：09564_toukyou⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{住|す}んでいます→住む：00673_sumu⟧。
おば⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ケーキ→ケーキ：01356_keeki⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}って→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦くれました→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My aunt made a cake for me.

examples.japanese: ⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧おば⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{家|いえ}→家：00612_ie⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{行|い}きました→行く：00119_iku⟧。⟦とても→とても：00593_totemo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しかった→楽しい：00817_tanoshii⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧。
examples.english: I went to my aunt's house last month. It was a lot of fun.

examples.japanese: おば⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{母|はは}→母：00549_haha⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姉|あね}→姉：00571_ane⟧で、⟦{子供|こども}→子供：00554_kodomo⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{時|とき}→時：02918_toki⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{私|わたし}→私：02988_watashi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦こと→こと：01164_koto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かわいがって→かわいがる：12327_kawaigaru⟧⟦くれました→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: My aunt is my mother's older sister, and she has been fond of me since I was a child.

notes:
おば refers to one's own aunt. It is used when speaking about your aunt to others (humble/neutral context).

KANJI FORMS:
- {伯母|おば}: aunt who is older than your parent
- {叔母|おば}: aunt who is younger than your parent
- In casual writing, おば is often left in hiragana

POLITENESS LEVELS:
- おば: plain form (for your own aunt when speaking to others)
- ⟦おばさん→おばさん：00801_obasan⟧: polite form (for someone else's aunt, or general address)
- おばさま: very polite form

WATCH OUT:
⟦おばさん→おばさん：00801_obasan⟧ can also be used as a general term for middle-aged women, which some people find rude. Be careful with context.

RELATED WORDS:
- ⟦おじ→おじ：00979_oji⟧: uncle
- おば: aunt
- ⟦{祖母|そぼ}→{祖母|そぼ}：00813_sobo⟧/⟦おばあさん→おばあさん：02863_obaasan⟧: grandmother (do not confuse おば with おばあさん)
